subject: Human Body
title: What Are Hormones?
description: Learn What Are Hormones? in one minute.

hook.text: A tiny drop of adrenaline can make your heart pound in under a second.

buildup.text: Hormones are released by glands into the bloodstream. They travel to distant organs and trigger specific actions.

discovery.text: Unlike nerves that send electrical signals, hormones work chemically. They're slower but affect the entire body at once.

twist.text: Hormones work at incredibly low concentrations — parts per billion.

climax.text: Hormones regulate mood, growth, metabolism, and reproduction.

punchline.text: Tiny molecules, massive effects. That's the hormone system.

quiz.question: How do hormones travel through the body?
